decisions.note: analytics_daily, user_activity_daily and the Scala usage rollup are in scope; the three housekeeping crons are excluded

finance-report-endpoint decodes INV_STATUS via CODES (services/legacy-billing/app/reports.py:46-70) while slice-0 is lakebase; proposal: CODES also landed in ow_tp as a static seed (schema/03_seed_static.sql) owned by slice-0, refreshed by the s3 pipeline

facade /me and /customer read CUSTOMER_MASTER and ENTITY_ATTR_VALUE (services/legacy-billing/app/facade.py:123,287,294), which s3 lands on Delta; proposal: those two reads go through the s3 api route; alternative is a Lakebase synced copy
